about_body:
{app_name}
Version {version}

An offline dialogue extraction suite tailored for The Choice Voicer game dialogue pack format.

• Faster-Whisper Speech Recognition
• Silero VAD & Pyannote Diarization
• RoFormer & Demucs Audio Stem Separation
• Lossless Frame Extraction

Developed with Python & PySide6.

dlg_repair_dont_ask: Do not ask again (Always auto-repair missing assets without prompting)
mcp_overwrite: Replace the existing ZIP at the selected destination? No leaves the file unchanged.
mcp_warning: Experimental; release validation is incomplete. External AI providers may send permitted data to their cloud. Captions are untrusted data. These permissions do not sandbox the AI's own shell/filesystem tools. Disabled on every launch; connections expire with the app/project.
mcp_live_hint: Select your AI app and access level, then Connect. First-time runtime setup runs automatically if needed. Reconnect your AI app after configuration is saved.
mcp_live_status: MCP ready locally | Connected AI clients: {count}
mcp_scope_read_transcript: Transcript captions (may reach external AI cloud)
mcp_scope_pipeline: Request pipeline (review options and model downloads)
mcp_interpreter: Select Python from the optional MCP environment
mcp_interpreter_hint: Copied syntax is a stdio example, not universal client configuration. Select an absolute interpreter with MCP, PySide6 and secure OS keyring installed. No automatic installs.
mcp_approve: Approve selected request once (expires in 5 minutes)
mcp_error: MCP: {code}. Check permissions, current project/revision and optional dependencies. No secrets are logged.
mcp_disable_jobs: Running jobs remain visible. Yes: request cooperative cancellation. No: let approved jobs finish. Cancel: keep the bridge enabled. Threads are never killed.
mcp_workflow_save: Choose destination in Save As; approve overwrite there. No agent path is accepted.
mcp_workflow_export: Choose output/options in the existing export dialog. Repair requires separate approval every time. No agent path is accepted.
mcp_workflow_pipeline: Review these existing settings and configured output. Model downloads and CPU/GPU use may occur. Approve only if permitted; change options in Settings first.
mcp_quick_steps: 1. Choose Read only or Review captions. 2. Start & copy; choose your MCP Python once. 3. Add a local STDIO server in your AI client's MCP settings, then reconnect and ask it to use voicer-studio. This does not install a plugin or configure the AI client automatically.
mcp_copy_no_connection: Nothing copied yet. Click Start & copy connection first. If you already have several connections, select one from the list before copying.
mcp_config_placeholder: Your copied connection configuration will appear here. No credential is included.
mcp_copy_cancelled: Copy cancelled: no Python interpreter selected. Choose Python with MCP, PySide6 and keyring installed.
mcp_copied: Copied to clipboard. Paste the selected format into your AI client's MCP configuration and reconnect. The local bridge alone does not mean the AI is connected.
mcp_clipboard_failed: Clipboard could not be verified. Select and copy the configuration shown below manually.
mcp_simple_consent: Full assistance permits reading and editing project text, characters and clips, and requesting import, analysis, save and export. Actions use the approval policy in Advanced.
mcp_simple_off: MCP is off. Enable MCP to start the local connection.
mcp_connect_steps: 1. Enable MCP. 2. Choose your AI app and permissions. 3. Connect. Advanced is not required for connection.
mcp_target_manual: Other local MCP client — copy configuration
mcp_connect_hint: Click Connect to configure the selected app. This does not start or restart your AI app.
mcp_client_setup_busy: Connecting {client}… Preparing runtime if needed; first setup may require internet.
mcp_setup_reason_CODEX_CLI_MISSING: Codex CLI was not found in PATH or the desktop installation. Install/run Codex first, then retry Connect.
mcp_setup_reason_DEPENDENCY_MISSING: Click Prepare MCP runtime, or select an existing Python with requirements-mcp.txt under Advanced.
mcp_setup_reason_CLIENT_NOT_INSTALLED: Install and open the selected AI app once, then retry Connect. Claude Desktop automatic setup supports Windows/macOS.
mcp_setup_reason_MCP_CONFIG_CUSTOMIZED: Existing client configuration is customized or changed. It was not overwritten. Use the advanced copy configuration option to update it yourself.
mcp_setup_reason_MCP_NAME_CONFLICT: The voicer-studio name belongs to a different server. It was not overwritten. Resolve the conflict in your AI app settings.
mcp_setup_reason_default: Retry Connect or use the advanced configuration fallback. No connection is confirmed yet.
mcp_client_ready_codex: Codex configuration is ready. Reconnect MCP or start a new Codex chat. A live connection is confirmed only when the socket count above increases.
mcp_client_ready_claude: Claude Desktop configuration is ready. Fully quit and reopen Claude Desktop yourself. A live connection is confirmed only when the socket count above increases.
mcp_manual_ready: Configuration copied and shown below. Add it to your local MCP client and reconnect; automatic setup is not supported for this selection.
mcp_setup_ready: Codex configuration verified. Reconnect MCP or start a new Codex chat to load it; live sockets above indicate connections, not completed jobs. No copy/paste needed for Codex.
mcp_setup_error: Automatic Codex setup failed ({code}). Check the advanced panel: install optional dependencies or select a valid MCP Python / use configuration for another client. Nothing installs automatically.
mcp_scope_analyze_speakers: Analyze local clip voices (scores only, no raw audio)
mcp_scope_edit_clips: Add / split / merge / time / soft-delete clips, regenerate assets, project Undo/Redo
mcp_scope_manage_speakers: Create / rename / remove unused characters and enroll / clear reference voices
mcp_mode_hint: Applies to supported MCP requests and selected scopes only. Always remembers the approval preference, not credentials or permissions. Bridge remains off on startup. Existing destination/overwrite/repair/model workflow dialogs are not bypassed. This does not enable mouse, shell or whole-computer access in your AI client.
mcp_auto_confirm: Automatically approve pending and future requests for the selected connection using its existing permissions? Edits can change the project without another MCP approval click. Validation/revision/busy checks still apply. Save/export/pipeline retain their existing workflow dialogs. Revoke or switch to Ask to stop future automatic approval; already-started jobs require cancellation. Always remembers this choice for new connections, but does not grant permissions or enable the bridge on startup.
mcp_python_selected: Python selected: {path}. Click Copy configuration to update your connection.
mcp_error_dependency: Connection cannot be created: this app's Python environment is missing keyring. Install the existing app dependency there, then retry. The separate gateway Python also needs requirements-mcp.txt and PySide6. Nothing was authorized or copied.
mcp_approve_all_review: Review {count} current requests below before approving. This is not automatic approval of future requests and is not an atomic batch. Each request is revalidated; edits can make later requests stale. Save/export/pipeline still show their existing confirmation dialogs.
mcp_approve_all_result: Approval accepted: {accepted}. Rejected or changed: {rejected}. Accepted does not mean a background job has finished. Check each job's state; stale requests must be proposed again.
video_theora_missing: FFmpeg does not provide the required libtheora encoder
dlg_pack_workspace: Choose a folder to store the imported pack for editing
mcp_runtime_installing: Installing the MCP runtime in .venv-mcp. Internet is needed for this step only. No AI models are downloaded.
mcp_runtime_ready: MCP runtime is ready. Choose permissions, select your AI app, then click Connect.
mcp_connection_testing: Testing MCP initialization, tool discovery and the connection to Voicer Studio...
mcp_connection_verified: Connection verified: a real MCP stdio client initialized, listed tools and read the app status. This does not confirm that your AI app has connected.
mcp_setup_reason_PYTHON_MISSING: A working Python 3.10–3.13 is needed. Choose its python.exe under Advanced, then prepare the runtime again.
mcp_setup_reason_RUNTIME_INSTALL_FAILED: Could not install the MCP runtime. Check your internet connection, disk space and Python, then retry. Existing models and application dependencies were not replaced.
mcp_setup_reason_CONNECTION_CHECK_FAILED: The MCP connection test failed. Enable MCP, prepare the runtime and retry.
mcp_setup_reason_APP_NOT_READY: Enable MCP and create a connection in this Voicer Studio instance, then retry Test connection.
mcp_client_ready_claude-code: Claude Code configuration saved. Reconnect voicer-studio in /mcp or start a new session. The live client count confirms an actual connection.
mcp_client_ready_cursor: Cursor configuration saved. Enable/reconnect voicer-studio in Cursor MCP settings. The live client count confirms an actual connection.
mcp_client_ready_vscode: VS Code configuration saved. Start/restart voicer-studio from MCP: List Servers. The live client count confirms an actual connection.
